title: Professional Hosting Programme Terms: Enrollment in Professional Host Plus
content:
# Professional Hosting Programme Terms — Enrollment in Professional Host Plus (Host Accounts)

## Term

The tier of a host account follows the order of precedence of the tier assignment, except that a Professional Host account moves into Professional Host Plus only when the host enrolls it in person, because the move carries the programme's service commitments; the enrollment places it in the tier its records qualify it for, and Enterprise Partner is never reached by an enrollment.

## What the term means for a Host Accounts holder

| Question | Answer under the term |
|---|---|
| Which accounts enroll? | Professional Host accounts |
| Who enrolls? | The host, in person |
| Why in person? | The move into Professional Host Plus carries the programme's service commitments |
| Which tier does an enrollment give? | The tier the account's records qualify it for: Professional Host Plus, or Professional Host |
| Can an enrollment reach Enterprise Partner? | No |

## Enrolling: `enroll_professional_tier_a874e389`

**Capability.** The tool enrolls a professional host account in the professional tier its records qualify it for, the host accepting the service commitments that come with the tier. One call rewrites the account's current host tier to the tier passed in, stamps today's date as the account's latest tier change, and clears the date Superhost status is counted from (a professional tier carries no Superhost status). Nothing else on the account changes. Afterwards the host account shows the new tier and its tier-change date to the host and to support.

**How it is invoked.** Enrollment is the host's own act: support unlocks the tool for the host with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `enroll_professional_tier_a874e389`, and the customer themselves then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, using the tool name and argument values support gives them.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `host_account_id` | The reference number of the host's own host account, as read out by support from the host account lookup | Reference number |
| `variant_name` | The professional tier the enrollment places the account in | `Professional Host` when the account's live listings and listing rating do not qualify it for the higher programme and it stays in the standard professional programme; `Professional Host Plus` when they qualify it for the higher programme. Never `Starter Host`, `Standard Host` or `Superhost` (an enrollment does not leave the professional programmes), and never `Enterprise Partner` (that tier rests on a signed partner agreement rather than an enrollment) |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation naming the host account reference number, the host tier now on the account and the tier-change date (YYYY-MM-DD, today's date). Its presence means the enrollment was recorded.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** Run with host account HA-4004 and tier `Professional Host Plus`, the tool returns a line stating that HA-4004 is enrolled in the Professional Host Plus tier as of today.
